claims.claim: The blanket never-replay rule was the disabled guarantee `if (false && !cancelled && call.replay === "safe" && tool?.replay === "safe")` in recoverToolInvocation; it has been repaired by removing the constant `false` and keeping the existing conditional restrictions.
A verified safe/safe, non-cancelled recovery clears the old checkpoint (which deletes the pending tool output and restores persisted arguments) before invocation.
The replayed invocation's outcome is published only after the invocation completes.
Unsafe, missing, and cancelled declarations still short-circuit to the interrupted outcome built from the durable checkpoint, without clearing or re-invoking.
Regression coverage asserts safe/safe replay ordering and the retained conditional restrictions against the real module.

validation.notes: Ran from the workspace root with Node v24.14.0: exits 0 ('regression: safe/safe replay and conditional restrictions verified'). The script loads the real packages/agent/src/harness/runtime/drive/tools.ts through .prale-eval/subject.mjs and asserts on the observed boundary events/outcome: (1) safe call policy + safe tool declaration, not cancelled -> exactly ['clear','invoke','effect-complete','publish'], i.e. the old checkpoint is cleared before invocation, the effect runs exactly once, and the real (isError:false) outcome is published last, with the cleared persisted args threaded into the invocation; (2) the same with an async effect resolves the effect before 'publish'; (3) cancelled safe/safe, safe-call/unsafe-tool, unsafe-call/safe-tool, unsafe/unsafe, absent tool, missing call policy, and a tool without a replay declaration all produce exactly ['read','publish'] with the synthetic interrupted outcome (checkpoint content preserved plus the interruption marker, details kept) and never invoke the tool. Failure detection was confirmed by temporarily restoring the original fault (`if (false && ...)`), where the script failed with an AssertionError at the safe/safe replay step (actual events ['read','publish'] vs expected ['clear','invoke','effect-complete','publish']); the fix was then restored and the script re-run green. Limitation: the repository's vitest suites (e.g. packages/agent/test/harness/runtime/drive-tools.test.ts, whose 'safe-replays persisted arguments and memos while interrupting unsafe effects' case encodes this behavior) could not be executed because node_modules is not installed and installing dependencies was out of scope; no dependency or network is needed for the regression above.
